headlines.summary_en: AI spending concerns and geopolitical risks hit U.S. stocks, with the S&P 500 recording its biggest monthly decline, Tesla falling over 14%, oil breaking $100, global bond yields rising again, and gold plunging. CSRC: Comprehensive measures to firmly maintain market stability, enhance capital market resilience, and promote steady increases in the scale and proportion of medium- to long-term funds entering the market. U.S. announces new tariff measures, effective on the 24th. AI demand triggers strongest growth in 15 years, with Intel's Q2 revenue surging 25%, well above expectations, guidance remains high, after-hours rally, supply shortages expected to persist, and capital expenditure next year far exceeding this year. U.S. Congress wants Trump to 'hit the brakes,' House passes resolution demanding halt to military operations against Iran. Trump says 'close' to deciding on 'massive attack,' Iran reportedly prepares for military escalation, especially ground invasion. SAP cloud business revenue grows 24%, exceeding expectations, cloud order backlog

headlines.summary_en: Thursday (July 23) New York close: U.S. 10-year Treasury yield rose 4.27 bps to 4.6972%. 2-year yield rose 5.35 bps to 4.3512%, accelerating from 19:00 to 22:09 Beijing time; 30-year yield rose 2.21 bps to 5.1669%. 2/10-year yield spread fell 1.072 bps to +34.387 bps. 10-year TIPS yield rose 5.52 bps to 2.4194%, widening further after U.S. Treasury auction results at 01:00; 2-year TIPS yield rose 3.46 bps to 2.3734%; 30-year TIPS yield rose 3.05 bps to 2.9649%.

headlines.title: Shanghai beats GDP estimates with 5.6% growth – but two-speed recovery persists
headlines.summary:
Shanghai’s economy expanded 5.6 per cent in the first half of the year, beating expectations on strong growth in hi-tech manufacturing and exports, even as weak consumer spending exposed the uneven nature of the recovery.
According to data released by the municipal statistics bureau on Monday, the reading surpassed both the national growth rate of 4.7 per cent for the same period and the city’s own growth rates in recent years, signalling a resilient rebound in the financial and commercial...
headlines.title_zh: 上海GDP增长5.6%超预期，但双速复苏态势延续
headlines.summary_zh:
上海市上半年经济同比增长5.6%，受高科技制造业和出口强劲增长推动，表现优于预期，但消费支出疲软凸显复苏不均衡。
根据市统计局周一发布的数据，该增速超过全国4.7%的增长水平

headlines.title: 中国人民银行今日开展5000亿元MLF操作
headlines.summary: 【中国人民银行今日开展5000亿元MLF操作】7月23日，中国人民银行发布2026年7月份中期借贷便利（MLF）招标公告。公告显示，为保持银行体系流动性充裕，2026年7月24日，中国人民银行将以固定数量、利率招标、多重价位中标方式开展5000亿元MLF操作，期限为1年期。

headlines.title_en: PBOC conducts 500 billion yuan MLF operation today
headlines.summary_en: 【PBOC conducts 500 billion yuan MLF operation today】On July 23, the PBOC issued a notice for the July 2026 Medium-term Lending Facility (MLF) tender. The notice stated that to maintain ample banking system liquidity, the PBOC will conduct a 500 billion yuan MLF operation on July 24, 2026, with a fixed quantity, rate-based bidding, and multiple-price awarding method, for a one-year term.

headlines.summary: 银行系公募资产管理规模座次生变。数据显示，截至今年二季度末，15家银行系公募总规模突破7万亿元，环比增长1837亿元。其中，以上海为“大本营”的多家银行系公募成为增长主力，依靠权益类产品、“固收+”产品等提升行业排名。当前，长期偏重固收的发展老路难以为继，银行系公募正在主动打破“固有印象”，寻找多元化的长期增长路径。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Leaving fixed-income 'comfort zone', bank-affiliated mutual funds' total scale exceeds 7 trillion yuan
headlines.summary_en: The asset management scale rankings among bank-owned public funds have shifted. Data shows that by the end of the second quarter, 15 bank-owned public funds had a total scale exceeding 7 trillion yuan, a quarter-on-quarter increase of 183.7 billion yuan. Among them, several bank-owned funds headquartered in Shanghai were the main growth drivers, improving industry rankings through equity products and 'fixed income +' products. Currently, the old path focused on fixed income is unsustainable, and bank-owned public funds are actively breaking the 'fixed perception' and seeking diversified long-term growth paths.

headlines.title: 7月以来机构调研近540家上市公司，多只绩优标的成“心头好”
headlines.summary: 7月以来已有近540家上市公司接待机构调研，其中超110家公司预计上半年净利润同比增长，部分业绩高增标的获得机构密集关注。近期A股进入调整阶段，对于后市走势，业内人士认为，在政策支持以及科技产业趋势仍在发展的背景下，未来市场情绪或逐步修复。对于科技板块，需要在波浪式前进中把握投资节奏，消费板块开始逐步具备配置价值，此外进入“击球区”的黄金也值得关注。（中证报）

headlines.title_en: Since July, institutions have surveyed nearly 540 listed companies, with multiple high-performing targets becoming favorites
headlines.summary_en: Since July, nearly 540 listed companies have received institutional surveys, with over 110 expecting an increase in net profit for the first half of the year. Some high-growth targets have drawn intensive institutional attention. As A-shares enter an adjustment phase, insiders believe market sentiment may gradually recover amid policy support and ongoing tech industry trends. For the tech sector, investment pacing in wave-like progress is needed; the consumer sector is beginning to show value, and gold, entering the 'sweet spot,' also warrants attention.

headlines.title: 今年上半年中国汽车出口超6000亿元，同比增长48.3%
headlines.summary: 今年上半年，我国汽车出口6358.2亿元，同比增长48.3%，销往全球210多个国家和地区。其中，新能源汽车出口3606.8亿元，同比增长68.7%。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: China's auto exports exceed 600 billion yuan in H1 2026, up 48.3% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: In the first half of this year, China's auto exports reached 635.82 billion yuan, up 48.3% year-on-year, shipped to over 210 countries and regions. Among them, new energy vehicle exports were 360.68 billion yuan, up 68.7% year-on-year.

headlines.title: 卡尼：针对美关税威胁，将“不惜一切代价”维护利益
headlines.summary: 据加拿大媒体报道，加拿大总理马克·卡尼23日表示，针对美国政府近期发出的关税威胁，加拿大政府将“不惜一切代价”维护本国利益。 卡尼当天在爱德华王子岛省夏洛特敦举行的全国地方领导人会议闭幕致辞中说，面对美方关税施压，加拿大政府将坚决保护和支持本国工人、农民、企业及家庭。

headlines.title_en: Carney: Will protect interests 'at all costs' against US tariff threats
headlines.summary_en: According to Canadian media, Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said on the 23rd that the Canadian government will 'spare no expense' to protect national interests in response to recent U.S. tariff threats. Speaking at the closing address of the national local leaders' conference in Charlottetown, Prince Edward Island, Carney said Canada will resolutely protect and support its workers, farmers, businesses, and families facing U.S. tariff pressure.

headlines.title: 公募FOF二季度“含科量”大幅提升，持仓策略已转向“凭配置做攻防”
headlines.summary: 公募基金二季报公开数据显示，截至二季度末，全市场共有619只公募FOF，相比一季度末增加了27只，规模合计为3112.84亿元，相比一季度末增加248.36亿元，增幅为8.67%。业绩是规模增长的核心原因。Choice数据显示，截至二季度末，全市场公募FOF近一年平均回报为20.41%，其中股票型FOF和偏股混合型FOF近一年的回报分别为32.87%和47.04%。展望下半年，多数FOF基金经理已经提前完成了“再平衡”，但依然对权益资产保持乐观。相比二季度，“向风格要收益”的策略已经逐渐转向“凭配置做攻防”。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Public-offered FOF 'tech content' significantly increased in Q2, with allocation strategy shifting to 'offense-defense via configuration'
headlines.summary_en: Public fund second-quarter reports show that as of the end of Q2, there were 619 public FOF products across the market, an increase of 27 from the end of Q1, with a total scale of 311.284 billion yuan, up 24.836 billion yuan from Q1, an increase of 8.67%. Performance is the core driver of scale growth. Choice data shows that as of the end of Q2, the average one-year return of public FOF funds was 20.41%, with equity FOF and equity-biased hybrid FOF returning 32.87% and 47.04% respectively over the past year. Looking ahead to the second half, most FOF managers have completed 'rebalancing' early but remain optimistic about equity assets. Compared to Q2, the strategy of 'seeking returns from style' is gradually shifting to 'offense and defense via allocation'.

headlines.title: A股科技板块持续调整，机构关注资源品与红利低位股
headlines.summary: 近期，A股科技板块明显调整，市场风险偏好有所回落。Wind数据显示，截至7月23日的近3个交易日，有色金属、电气设备、石油石化等板块率先获得资金回流，消费、红利和金融板块则呈现结构性机会。机构认为，本轮调整更多是外部扰动、交易拥挤和估值压力集中释放的结果，市场中长期运行逻辑并未发生根本变化。在半年报密集披露的窗口期，资金正由前期高弹性、高估值的方向，逐步转向业绩确定性更强、估值更具安全边际的板块。（中证报）

headlines.title_en: A-share tech sector continues to adjust; institutions focus on resource goods and low-dividend stocks
headlines.summary_en: Recently, A-share tech stocks have seen notable adjustments, with market risk appetite declining. Wind data shows that in the past three trading days to July 23, sectors like non-ferrous metals, electrical equipment, and oil & petrochemicals received initial capital inflows, while consumption, dividends, and finance showed structural opportunities. Institutions believe this round of adjustments is more a release of external disturbances, trading congestion, and valuation pressure, with the market's medium- to long-term logic unchanged. During the semi-annual report disclosure window, capital is shifting from high-beta, high-valuation directions to sectors with stronger earnings certainty and better valuation safety margins.
